{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tetrahedron''' was an ancient, [[pre-Republic era|pre-Republic]] description of an area of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was named such because a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspatial]] physicist believed that the planets of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], along with the [[Ginn Jump/Legends|Ginn Jump]], were the four vertices of a perfect geometric pyramid. However this notion was astrographically inaccurate, and somehow expressed the physicist's romanticism.<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

From the Tetrahedron, the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] were discovered, and a colonization wave expanded eastewards, forming [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]]. The Tetrahedron became afterwards known as the [[Arrowhead]] of the Slice, and contained many of the founding [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="atlas" />

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Doctor [[Insmot Bowen]], pre-Republic specialist at the [[Obroan Institute for Archaeology]], mentioned the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of the Tetrahedron during a conversation with [[Bevel Lemelisk]], Admiral [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] and General [[Arhul Kurumenga]], indicating that the term was still in use when related to historical events.
